an6.62:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikañcaramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena daṇḍakappakannāma kosalānaṃ nigamo tadavasari
an6.62:1.3: atha kho bhagavā maggā okkamma araññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle paññatte āsane nisīdi
an6.62:1.4: te bhikkhū daṇḍakappakaṃ pavisiṃsu āvasathaṃ pariyesituṃ
an6.62:2.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ yena aciravatī nadī tenupasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ
an6.62:2.2: aciravatiyā nadiyā gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubbasadisāni kurumāno
an6.62:2.3: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
an6.62:2.4: kinnu kho āvuso ānanda sabbaṃ cetaso samannāharitvā nu kho devadatto bhagavatā byākato
an6.62:2.5: āpāyiko devadatto nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekicchoti udāhu kenaci deva pariyāyenāti.
an6.62:2.6: evaṃ kho panetaṃ āvuso bhagavatā byākatanti.
an6.62:3.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an6.62:3.2: idhāhaṃ bhante sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ aciravatī nadī tenupasaṅkamiṃ gattāni parisiñcituṃ

an6.62:3.8: evaṃ kho panetaṃ āvuso bhagavatā byākatanti.
an6.62:4.1: so ca kho ānanda bhikkhu navo bhavissati acirapabbajito thero vā pana bālo abyatto
an6.62:4.2: kathaṃ hi nāma yaṃ mayā ekaṃsena byākataṃ tattha dvejjhaṃ āpajjissati
an6.62:4.3: nāhaṃ ānanda aññaṃ ekapuggalaṃpi samanupassāmi yo evaṃ mayā sabbaṃ cetaso samannāharitvā byākato yathayidaṃ devadatto
an6.62:4.4: yāvakīvañcāhaṃ ānanda devadattassa vālaggakoṭinittuddanamattampi sukkaṃ dhammaṃ addasaṃ
an6.62:4.7: yato ca kho ahaṃ ānanda devadattassa vālaggakoṭinittuddanamattampi sukkaṃ dhammaṃ na addasaṃ
an6.62:5.1: seyyathāpi ānanda gūthakūpo sādhiko poriso pūro gūthassa samatittiko
an6.62:5.3: tassa koci deva puriso upagaccheyya atthakāmo hitakāmo yogakkhemakāmo tamhā gūthakūpā uddharitukāmo
an6.62:5.4: so taṃ gūthakūpaṃ samantānuparigacchanto na passeyya tassa purisassa vālaggakoṭinittuddanamattampi gūthena amakkhitaṃ yattha taṃ gahetvā uddhareyya
an6.62:5.5: evameva kho ahaṃ ānanda yato devadattassa vālaggakoṭinittuddanamattampi sukkaṃ dhammaṃ na addasaṃ
an6.62:5.8: sace tumhe ānanda suṇeyyātha tathāgatassa purisindriyañāṇāni vibhajantassāti.
an6.62:6.1: etassa bhagavā kālo etassa sugata kālo
an6.62:6.2: yaṃ bhagavā purisindriyañāṇāni vibhajeyya bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
an6.62:6.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
